description: Intent i041 (error-unwind-poisoned-count, snapshot s10) complete. One finding reported: snapshots/s10/drivers/accel/qaic/qaic_control.c lines 964-1015 (poisoning store at line 979). Evidence: decode_message() stores the MHI device-reply count unclamped via `user_msg->count = le32_to_cpu(msg->hdr.count);` (979) with no range check, while the request-direction sibling qaic_manage() (lines 1259-1261) rejects `user_msg->count > QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH / sizeof(struct qaic_manage_trans_hdr)` — asymmetric validation of the same protocol count. Failure paths return early without resetting the shared manage_msg: decode_message returns -EINVAL at 985/991/1007/1010/1015; decode_status returns -ECANCELED at 957 (and -EPIPE on bad CRC) and decode_passthrough returns -ENOSPC at 845/867, all leaving the device-controlled count (and partially incremented len) in the object. Later consuming use: qaic_manage_ioctl() at lines 1349-1352, on the -ECANCELED error-unwind path, copies msg->data back to userspace and exports the poisoned count via `user_msg->count = msg->count;`. Counterevidence: the decode loop is bounded by msg_hdr_len checks (984/987) and msg->len by QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH, so no direct kernel OOB was proven — impact is unvalidated device-controlled count stored in shared state on failure paths and exported to userspace during error handling; confidence medium, consistent with the same device-reply-count family reported in sibling snapshots. Seed family verified patched/safe in s10 (drivers/usb/usbip/usbip_common.c: recv_iso clamp np<=0||np>USBIP_MAX_ISO_PACKETS at 685 with number_of_packets zeroed at 689, kcalloc allocation; pack_ret_submit clamps rpdu->number_of_packets to [0, urb->number_of_packets] at 482-485). Limitations: finalize directive stopped the sweep after the top prior lead — dm-era-target.c, dm-zoned-metadata.c, ubi fastmap, bnxt TPA, gve_adminq.c, and ixgbe_e610 error paths were not audited in s10; no compilation/static analysis/runtime reproducer was run (read-only snapshot). Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i041.json with snapshots_checked ["s10"].
